verses.21:42: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ

meaning: The root كُلْأَةٌ (kulʾah) refers to pasturage or herbage, something that is guarded or preserved. It is related to the idea of protection and sustenance for livestock.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
